text:
Rae (PM): Quick sync: assemble a one-page launch slate for private deploys covering packaging presets, upgrade lanes, and customer-network responsibilities. Need language sales can paste.
Ike (Eng): Keep it compact: presets + three upgrade lanes (auto, scheduled, pinned). Call out that pinned = storage + migration tradeoffs.
Marta (Infra): Ops checklist to include: required customer artifacts for preserved IP (IP block, ASN if needed, network contact), expected rollback delta for pinned versions (+30-90m), and telemetry opt-out caveats.
Claire (Sales): Field ask: give me two snappy lines per preset. Example: 'Minimal: self-serve, best-effort egress, automated rolling upgrades.' Want one for 'Managed' that mentions monthly blackout slot.
Theo (Solutions): From pilots: financial customers want monthly reserved blackout + IP reservation. Also require a named network owner in SOW.
Rae (PM): Draft presets (docs will include YAML snippets):
```yaml
preset: minimal
telemetry: opt_in
upgrade_policy: automated_rolling
egress_ip: best_effort
blackout: none
```
```yaml
preset: managed
telemetry: opt_out
upgrade_policy: scheduled_with_customer
egress_ip: reserved_on_request
blackout: monthly_slot
```
```yaml
preset: enterprise
telemetry: off_by_default
upgrade_policy: pinned_or_scheduled
egress_ip: contract_reserved
blackout: contractual
```
Marta (Infra): Add ops footnote: 'Pinned versions increase storage usage and KV migration complexity; expect longer restore windows.'
Ike (Eng): Also propose a small "pricing hint" line: 'Monthly blackout slots are add-on; per-event holds have a higher operational surcharge.' (sales to firm up).
Claire (Sales): I'll draft two one-liners per preset and sample pricing bands and drop by EOD Thurs.
Rae (PM): Legal/contract snippet for SOW: 'Customer blackout windows are enforceable only for Enterprise tier when enumerated in the SOW; all other tiers are best-effort.' Put prerequisites: customer provides IP reservation and network contact.
infra-bot: Created ticket PRIV-999: "Launch slate - presets + network clauses" assigned to Rae.
Rae (PM): Action items: Ike -> finalize YAML examples + perf expectations; Marta -> ops footnotes and rollback numbers; Claire -> quote lines and pricing; Theo -> two pilot examples for appendix. Will collate and publish draft tomorrow. :thumbsup:
